name: Coconut Chicken and Chickpea Curry

fit.note: 479 cal (400-650 band OK), 21g carbs (<=35 OK), no seafood, one-pot simmer scales cleanly to 14.

catalog_dupe_check: Not a catalog duplicate: closest live recipe is kuku-paka-swahili-coconut-chicken-curry (chicken thigh + coconut milk + tomato), but that is a Swahili rice-served curry with no legume, whereas this is an Indian coconut-cream chicken+chickpea curry - the chickpeas make it a distinct legume-forward plate; other catalog chicken curries (cape-malay, madras, slow-cooker) share none of the coconut+chickpea combination.

pool_collisions.evidence: Same dish structure: chicken-thigh + coconut-cream + curry-spice stovetop braise (3 of 4 factors match; differs only in chickpeas vs broccoli). golden is the STRONGER twin (16g carbs vs 21g, distinct Malaysian aromatics - star anise/cinnamon/garam masala/fennel - widen cuisine spread more than this generic Indian curry-powder profile; same recipetineats source). Recommend decider keep only ONE coconut chicken curry and likely prefer golden-coconut-chicken-curry; this candidate is the weaker of the pair.

Already accepted this run; also a chicken-thigh + legume (yellow split peas/dal) curry braise. NOT a duplicate - burmese is coconut-free, paprika/turmeric water-based, whole different sauce family. Flagged only because both occupy the 'chicken + legume curry' niche and the catalog should not over-index it.

cross_protein_watch: Structurally a coconut-cream + curry-spice + chickpea braise where the protein is swappable; watch for a turkey or pork coconut-chickpea/coconut-legume curry twin in other selectors' pools (catalog already has thai-coconut-curry-turkey-meatballs and curry-ground-turkey-bowls in the coconut-curry space).
recommendation: KEEP as borderline. Fits all conditions and adds an Indian coconut-chickpea curry the catalog lacks, but it directly overlaps golden-coconut-chicken-curry in-pool - decider should not ship both coconut chicken curries; if forced to one, golden is the better pick.
